_note: Keys on the menu screens (M7 travel adds the song screen's, keymap travel: a held key plays its note once), by the keymap the core names in ui().keymap: each key code and the word the page sends as act('<keymap>.key', word). The core decides what each word does (crates/core/src/ui.rs, menu_key and next_line). 'repeat' lists the words a held key sends again; the rest go once a press. In play the keys go through data/controls.json instead.
